name: Bella-Anna's Head
source:
2008, Spring. The Bella-Anna's body was found near the railroad tracks. There was no head on the body. No one can find the girl's killer. And the head. But no one knows... That the head has been with me for a long time.

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/bella-annas-head]Itch.io[/url]]
